_about: GameSheet games the club says were never played. .github/scripts/fill_league_games.py drops them from data/schedule-<team>.json after every GameSheet pull, so the site and the team calendars stop showing them. Key: team, then GameSheet game id (gamesheetstats.com/seasons/<season>/games/<id>). Remove an entry if the game is rescheduled under the same id.
